memory_update.text: APD and ENTG are the clearest U.S.-listed direct supplier anchors for critical semiconductor materials and consumables.
GFS is a useful demand-side anchor because it explicitly emphasizes diversified non-China/non-Taiwan supply and high-purity materials dependence.
ESI is a lower-attention specialty-chemicals exposure with meaningful semiconductor packaging and wafer-level packaging leverage.

The pure-play U.S.-listed quartz/high-purity input and crucible chain still looks sparse in this layer; many of the most direct upstream names are foreign or private and should be handled in a separate pass.

summary: The cleanest U.S.-listed exposure here clusters into two buckets: direct materials/consumables suppliers and direct foundry customers that depend on high-purity inputs and diversified supply.
